name: XCC_PROCESS_ERRORS
description: This table stores the processing errors encountered during the budget import program.

columns.name: PROCESS_ERROR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the process error.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION
columns.description: The source budget system for where the budget data is prepared

columns.name: SOURCE_BUDGET
columns.description: The source budget in the source budget system for which the budget data is prepared

columns.name: DATA_SET
columns.description: The data set which failed validations

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Foreign key to the interface table.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: The impacted control budget that failed validations. If the error is independent of a control budget, -1 is stored

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: The budget period that failed validations

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: The error code of the error message

columns.name: ERROR_ACCOUNT
columns.description: The budget account that failed validations

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_ERROR_TEXT
columns.description: Additional error message related to processing the budget account key flexfield.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
